reason: The patch deletes `padding-top: 4px` from `.small-action-desc > p` (app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/topic-post.scss:301-303), and no other stylesheet rule sets padding on a `p` inside `.small-action-desc`. The mobile override `p { padding-top: 0 }` at app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/topic-post.scss:517-519 therefore resets a value that is already the default and has no effect.
